summary: {person} brings messages assigning shifts to support a complaint about cash pay.
realLife: Denver investigators used a tobacco shop worker's texts about schedules and pay when the employer lacked usable payroll records.
gates: A cash-paid worker has saved messages about assigned shifts.
weights: Missing payroll increases the value of dated messages.
inGame: needs: dated schedule messages, the method of payment and actual pay.

turns.what: The employer supplies a complete register.
turns.writesBack: Investigators compare the register with the messages.

turns.what: Only some shifts can be dated.
turns.writesBack: The claim separates supported weeks from unresolved weeks.
